details: VELDO-0144 detail: catalog/stdio: every field of revision 1 round trips through API and SQLite; every field of revision 2 round trips through API and SQLite
VELDO-0144 detail: catalog/http: every field of revision 1 round trips through API and SQLite; every field of revision 2 round trips through API and SQLite

VELDO-0144 detail: catalog/host-command: stdio host-signed authority command stores revision 1; stdio host-signed authority command stores revision 2; http host-signed authority command stores revision 1; http host-signed authority command stores revision 2
VELDO-0144 detail: catalog/immutable-history: both revisions of both transports survive byte for byte after the later save
VELDO-0144 detail: catalog/stale-unauthorized: stale, unauthorized and forged saves refuse by name and write nothing; a live passkey session whose owner role was removed cannot write
VELDO-0144 detail: catalog/invalid: invalid transports, fields and value/reference shapes store no definition
VELDO-0144 detail: catalog/atlassian: Atlassian is an ordinary http definition with its reference resolvable in the keystore
VELDO-0144 detail: credential/write: TLS passkey write stores only the five metadata fields and resolves through keychain; the opaque runtime handle prints only its reference
VELDO-0144 detail: credential/replace-delete: replacement keeps the reference and resolves only the new value; deletion clears the keystore item and runtime resolution refuses
VELDO-0144 detail: credential/read-back: written: read-back is refused by name; replaced: read-back is refused by name; deleted: read-back is refused by name
VELDO-0144 detail: credential/no-value-on-command-line: the fake reads the exact value from stdin and checks every live process argv
VELDO-0144 detail: credential/no-value-in-records: during and after writes no value appears in store, journal, feed, proof or logs [False, 200, True, True, True, True]

VELDO-0144 detail: credential/keystore-refusals: locked refuses by name, commits no record and has no fallback; unreachable refuses by name, commits no record and has no fallback; missing executable refuses without touching any real keystore
VELDO-0144 detail: credential/authority-binding: current role, base, passkey, forgery guard and signed value binding are enforced; a live passkey session whose owner role was removed cannot write
VELDO-0144 detail: catalog/observability: save and credential observations join actor, revision, session and command; metrics count operations
VELDO-0144 detail: install/assets: new runtime assets are installed, derive into the authority closure, and match engine copies
VELDO-0144 detail: catalog/credential-literals: environment is refused before any write; arguments is refused before any write; url is refused before any write
VELDO-0144 detail: catalog/credential-domain: reference must belong to a credential recorded in this domain; reference must belong to a credential recorded in this domain
VELDO-0144 detail: credential/libsecret-protocol: lookup preserves a real newline, matches all attributes, and store requires label
VELDO-0144 detail: credential/replay-value: identical retry is idempotent; changed value refuses before touching keystore
VELDO-0144 detail: credential/encoding: invalid Unicode refuses by name, writes nothing and records an API observation
VELDO-0144 detail: credential/deleted-state: deleted record carries a tombstone; set after delete is a write and removes the tombstone; replaying a recreation preserves its written outcome
